start.npcText: You're the one from the hill! Good — you'll have a clear head. Look, here in the flour: that's the brook, that's the pool, and if we cut a race from HERE the wheel turns all summer. Da won't look at it properly.

responses.text: Garrow says cut it above the pool, not through it.

above_the_pool.npcText: Above the — hold on. Hold ON. That's the same fall of water and it leaves his trout alone. That's... that's better than mine. Did he say that himself? Garrow Bream said that?

responses.text: He did. Take it to your father as yours.
He did. He'd rather it came from you.
